payload.example_text: *1007* $ZLM5, CAN'T GRANT LINK: *1034* $ZLM5, NO SERVER AVAILABLE FOR REQUESTING TCP

manual.cause: PATHMON cannot grant a link: no server process is available (all linked or at MAXLINKS).
manual.effect: The requesting link manager is not linked to the server class.
manual.recovery: Increase MAXSERVERS, MAXLINKS or LINKDEPTH for the server class.
